Add mean(), median() and mode() to src/math.js, each taking an array of numbers. Each throws a TypeError naming the position of the first element that is not a finite number. mean([]) and median([]) throw a RangeError; mode([]) returns undefined. median() of an even-length array is the mean of the two middle values, and mode() returns the smallest of the most frequent values. Each is a named export with one JSDoc comment.
